scope: Four top-status sections only. Labels original P2 and past review/Draft actions as history, links implemented R1/current maintained PR records, retains direct user attestation and all separate release gates.
checked: Read exact patch and manual checklist; no frozen legal bytes, source, tests or current release requirements change.
